execution_model.venue: backtrader BackBroker (Cerebro, preload=False, runonce=False), offline; no live venue, no Kite
execution_model.decision_time: close of the completed 1-minute bar (bar label + 1 minute)
execution_model.entry_reference_price: decision bar close (the next open is unknown at decision time)
execution_model.entry_fill: Backtrader market order, filled at the OPEN of the symbol's next delivered bar, adverse slippage_perc, capped at that bar's high/low
execution_model.exit_fill: R5 decides the exit on the completed bar (stop/target touched intrabar, governor, plant, time); Backtrader fills a market order at the next bar's OPEN.  No intrabar stop fills.
execution_model.same_bar_assumption: none: no order ever fills on the bar that produced its decision
execution_model.partial_fills: only with volume_fill_perc (Backtrader FixedBarPerc filler); entry remainder cancelled after the first execution, exit remainder keeps working at later bars
execution_model.end_of_data: open positions stay open and are reported with Backtrader's unrealized P&L; working orders are cancelled natively

realized_gross_vs_r5_trades.note: Backtrader execution-bit P&L vs R5 trade-ledger gross (+ realized P&L of exits still working)

commission_vs_r5_fill_model.note: Backtrader commission scheme vs R5 leg_cost, both per fill

commission_vs_r5_trade_ledger.note: R5 trade ledger charges leg_cost on each aggregated leg; a partially filled order is charged per fill (Rs 20 brokerage cap per fill).  Explained = per-fill minus per-leg charges.
